note: Every known answer in content/verify/fixtures/cases.json that was revised after the model sweep ran (content/verify/sweep-results.json, run 2026-11-06), each with its date, its case id, the answer as it stood when the sweep ran (`was`), the answer today (`now`), and why. The sweep is scored first against the `was` answers, as the sweep report printed it, and second against today's (sweepSettings() in src/components/judges/errors.ts); tests/facts.test.ts fails when the first does not match the sweep's own pass marks, or when a case in cases.json differs from its `now` here.

changes.why: Recall 25007 asks for two photos, one of both straps cut off and one of the helmet in a trash can. This is the second, and on its own it does not show the straps cut, so a request for the other photo is the right answer. Every setting in the three-trial sweep read it that way (made safe: fail, 12 of 12).

What matters for a look-alike is that it is never paid. Sending it to a person and asking for a new photo both keep the refund for the recalled product, so either is a right answer. No setting paid it (0 of 12).
